retrieved.title: Tier 1 signature for FOILED-DEMO-0001
retrieved.text: Synthetic advisory FOILED-DEMO-0001 for the Foiled demo app. Matches POST /api/upload where the path parameter climbs out of the upload directory (dot-dot segments or their encoded forms) or is absolute. A probe can match this too; the vulnerable-path hook is the stronger signal.

retrieved.title: Foiled demo app 1.0.0
retrieved.text: Catalogue entry foiled/demo-app/1.0.0 for the synthetic FOILED-DEMO-0001: unauthenticated arbitrary file write via POST /api/upload with a crafted path parameter. Severity critical. Expected techniques: T1190, T1505.003.
